sloka: द्विजाश्च नेदुर्घोराश्च सञ्चचालेव मेदिनी।ववर्ष रुधिरं देवश्चस्खलुस्तुरगाः पथि ।। ६.९६.३५ ।।
transliteration: dvijāśca nedurghorāśca sañcacāleva medinī।vavarṣa rudhiraṁ devaścaskhalusturagāḥ pathi ।। 6.96.35 ।।

translations.english: His left eye twitched, left arm quivered, face turned pale and indeed his tone became hoarse.
